name: Midnight at Maple Mall
description: You fell asleep in the beanbag aisle and the mall locked up for the night! Explore the Toy Kingdom, Pet Paradise, Arcade, Cinema and Food Court, find 6 security keycards, hunt 20 lost coins and 3 secret golden ducks, then unlock the Loading Dock and escape before morning. An after-hours adventure by gooberr478.
author: gooberr478

🗺️ MAPLE MALL DIRECTORY: Toy Kingdom & Pet Paradise (west) · Arcade & Cinema (east) · Food Court & Loading Dock (north). Find 6 keycards to unlock the dock!
💡 Tip: touch glowing keycards 🔑, spin-y coins 🪙 and secret golden ducks 🦆. Stairs to the upper walkway are on the left.
⛲ Beware the cleaning bots! They bump you a little when you touch them.
🧸 Toy Kingdom: "A keycard glitters in the castle courtyard... and something golden sits atop the tallest block tower."
🐹 Pet Paradise: "The hamsters hoard shiny things up on their shelf. Hop the crates!"
📚 Bookworm: "Some books are not meant for reading... one of them pulls back." Press the pink book.
👟 Sneaker Hub: grab the Pogo Boots (gravity coil) from the try-on bench. Press its number to equip!
🕹️ Arcade Galaxy: the prize case opens for 8 Lost Change tokens. Check your coin count!
🎬 Starlight Cinema: "The projectionist always sat dead center of the back row." The ledge above holds a golden duck.
💻 Tech Zone: a sticky note says "Booth door opens from the middle seat - row nearest the exit."
🍭 Sweet Treats: sugar rush! Coins hide behind the candy jars.
🍔 Food Court: a keycard sits on the pizza oven. The service elevator (back right) needs 3 keycards.
🌃 Rooftop Garden: the telescope holds the last keycard. Look through it! (touch the glowing card)
🛍️ Upper walkway: the view is great and the loose change is even better.
🚪 Loading Dock gate: it needs all 6 keycards. Gus has the key reader... if he would stop snoring.
